samples.stimulus: Researchers recorded the time a cake bakes and the cake's internal temperature for 10 cases. The scatterplot shows the data and its line of best fit.
samples.question: Which statement correctly interprets the y-intercept of the line of best fit shown?
options: The data show that the cake's internal temperature was exactly 80 degrees when the time a cake bakes was 0.
For each 1-minute increase in the time a cake bakes, the line predicts the cake's internal temperature to increase by 80 degrees.
The line of best fit predicts the cake's internal temperature to be 80 degrees when the time a cake bakes is 0.
The line of best fit predicts the cake's internal temperature to be 6 degrees when the time a cake bakes is 0.
samples.answer: The line of best fit predicts the cake's internal temperature to be 80 degrees when the time a cake bakes is 0.
samples.explanation: (1) 그림에서 직선 위의 두 격자점 (0, 80) 과 (10, 140) 를 읽는다. (2) 기울기 m = (140 - 80) ÷ (10 - 0) = 6, y 절편 b = 80, 식은 y = 6x + 80 이다. (3) y 절편은 x = 0 일 때 직선의 y 값 80 이다. (4) 절편은 예측값이지 관측값이 아니며, 변화율은 기울기의 의미이다. (5) 따라서 x 가 0 일 때 80 를 예측한다는 서술이 맞다. 따라서 정답은 C이다.
